senses.gloss: ह्यस् [hyas], ind. [गते अहनि नि˚] Yesterday. -Comp. -भव a. what occurred yesterday.
ह्यस्तन [hyastana], a. (-नी f.) Belonging to yesterday; as in ह्यस्तनी वृत्तिः, ह्यस्तनेन च कोपेन शक्तिं वै प्राहिणोन्मयी Mb.5. 184.4. -Comp. -दिनम् yesterday, the previous day.
ह्यस्त्य [hyastya], a. Belonging to yesterday, hesternal; P. IV.2.15.
